import json
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')];rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for c in cards[49:]:rows.append(dict(card_id=c['card_id'],letters='y',marks='y',crop_ok='y',errors=[],detail='',owner_crop={k:'no' for k in ['one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped']},where=[],segmentation_detail=''))
for i in [51,52,54,55]:rows[i-1]['marks']='na'
rows[39]['detail']='ἀδρά → ἁδρά'
r=rows[48];r['marks']='n';r['errors'].append('extra_mark');r['detail']='φέρη → φέρῃ; ” → \\"'
r=rows[52];r.update(crop_ok='n',errors=['hyphen','crop_clipped'],detail='διατά- → διατά',where=[{'label':'διατά','printed':'διατά-'}],segmentation_detail='Right edge runs through the line-end hyphen after διατά.');r['owner_crop'].update(text_ne_visible_line='yes',turned_or_clipped='yes')
r=rows[55];r.update(letters='n',errors=['missing_word_or_span'],detail='περιβάλω σκότος. → περιβάλω',where=[{'label':'','printed':' σκότος.'}],segmentation_detail='Complete visible final word σκότος. is omitted from the label.');r['owner_crop']['text_ne_visible_line']='yes'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r in rows:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(cards)==len(rows)
assert [c['card_id'] for c in cards]==[r['card_id'] for r in rows]
assert len({r['card_id'] for r in rows})==len(rows)
for r in rows:
 assert set(r)=={'card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where','segmentation_detail'}
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
from collections import Counter
print('Count and order verified:',len(rows))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(Counter(r[k] for r in rows)))
print('errors',Counter(e for r in rows for e in r['errors']).most_common())
